## Folder Passthrough Iframe Site

# Folder Passthrough Iframe Site

A demo of embedding a static passthrough app folder via `![[/folder/]]`.

The `app/` folder has an `index.html` but no markdown index, so it
classifies as `FolderIndexIframe` and renders as an `<iframe>`.
